description: Chiggi Patches v1.14.1 — CrazyGames fix: adds 'Bypass Play license check', which neuters Google Play's Automatic Integrity Protection (PairIP) license check that, on a re-signed/sideloaded build, redirected the app to the Play Store ('get it on Google Play'). Required for the patched app to open. CrazyGames patches: Remove ads (native AdMob: interstitial/banner hidden; rewarded ads auto-grant their reward without playing a video), Disable analytics (native Sentry telemetry), Remove AD_ID, Change app name -> 'CrazyGames Morphe' (package kept so Google/Facebook/Apple login still works). Note: in-page web video ads served remotely inside the WebView are not in the app bytecode and remain. Apps: SonyLIV (com.sonyliv 6.23.1), Nutrilio (net.nutrilio 1.20.2), Threads (com.instagram.barcelona 434.0.0.41.74), Arrow Puzzle (com.easybrain.arrow.puzzle.game 1.7.0), CrazyGames (com.crazygames.crazygamesapp 1.6.7).
